projects.name: YOLO Smart Vehicle
projects.description: Smart Vehicle (originally Pametno Vozilo) is an open-source educational and research Edge AI robotics platform powered by Raspberry Pi 5, with on-vehicle YOLO vision and a native Android teleoperation client. Teleoperation and on-device vision are the foundation; more advanced autonomy is on the roadmap.
features: Raspberry Pi 5 with 8GB RAM, Pi Camera Module v2, Mecanum wheels, L298N motor drivers, and XL4015 step-down power converter
Separate camera processing, inference, and motor control using multithreaded pipelines and Docker services
Native Android client with live video, drive controls, telemetry, and Google ML Kit text recognition; YOLO detection runs on the Pi
Smart Network monitors connectivity and provides a fallback local hotspot when external Wi-Fi drops
Model Pipeline optimizes, quantizes, and exports YOLO models for TFLite and ONNX
4th place and Special Award at the 10th Galaksija Cup National STEM Championship
MIT-licensed project created by Danilo Stoletović at ETŠ Nikola Tesla in Niš; mentor Predrag Šubarević, former mentor Dejan Batanjac
LiDAR and SLAM, accessible programming tools, and clearer replication guides are planned directions, not shipped capabilities

projects.name: Class Timetable
projects.description: Open-source cross-platform scheduling app for students and educators.
features: Academic scheduling across platforms
One to eight week rotations anchored to a reference start date
Subject colors, room, teacher, notes, ongoing-class highlighting and local reminders
JSON backup and restore via files or clipboard; manual transfer rather than cloud sync

projects.name: PromptUI
projects.description: Experimental local single-user AI workspace that streams interactive task-shaped interfaces with OpenUI.
features: Streamed tables, charts, forms, and steps with conversational follow-ups
Source inspection, cancellation, text fallback and interface repair
Explicit offline demo; session-only chat history; no external tool execution
In beta

projects.name: Personal Portfolio
projects.description: Personal website built with semantic HTML and vanilla CSS, plus a small launcher and optional lazy-loaded AI secretary. Portfolio content remains readable without JavaScript.
features: Public-web deployment and separately hosted Tor mirror
Static English and Serbian pages, Markdown portfolio and public discovery resources
Responsive light/dark themes and optional progressive project inspection
Five-project archive with engineering decisions, roles and evidence
Website, app, AI and infrastructure service paths; buyer FAQ and direct contact
Portfolio remains readable without JavaScript; Ana uses a separate Worker, not duplicated AI logic

projects.name: Secretary
projects.description: AI assistant integrated with Danilo's portfolio that helps visitors understand his projects, services, technical experience, and whether his skills may fit their project.
features: Portfolio questions and potential-client guidance
Server-side curated public knowledge
Stateless server; each request can supply optional bounded conversation history, and the browser keeps session history
